name: agent-skills

check.desc: Check the documentation against the justfile and the registry order

ci.desc: Everything CI runs: justfile docs, Markdown lint, skill checks

help.desc: Full command reference, or the focused docs of one group or command (help [group] [term]); -b browses, -j emits JSON

md-fix.desc: Apply the rumdl fixes to the Markdown files (rewrites them)
md-fix.detail: Rewrites files in place. Read the diff before you commit it: some fixes change words, see skills/rumdl/references/pitfalls.md. Findings without an automatic fix remain; run md-lint afterwards.

md-lint.desc: Lint the Markdown files with rumdl and the rules in .rumdl.toml

exits.1: a finding, or rumdl is missing

skills-check.desc: Check every skill: frontmatter, SKILL.md size, links that leave the skill, catalog entry

tagline: Agent skills for developer tools, published on skills.sh
